Megan —

Appreciate the checklist and the clear ask. High level answers below; we'll follow up with attachments/examples by tomorrow.

1) SKU / entitlement model
- We typically publish a consumable SKU per product with metering bands (e.g., 0-1M tokens, 1M-10M). For a connector pattern we can suggest a bundling SKU or a usage pass for API calls. I'll attach a sample SKU mapping doc.

2) Technical evidence
- We can provide: sample API call traces, 95th/99th latency buckets for standard 2k prompts, and an integration guide outlining the auth flow (API key / OAuth). See: connector-integration-overview.pdf (attached).

3) Metering / billing model
- Redwood supports token metering and event metering; for co-sell we recommend token-based metering with a per-1000-token price and a separate charge for embedding ingestion if applicable. We can produce an expected monthly cost model for Catalyst's projected volumes.

4) Co-sell certs / enablement
- Vivek and Olga can lead the co-sell certification: short training (90 min) + demo kit. We also run a sales playbook session with the partner sales org.

5) Timeline
- If we receive the minimal evidence (sample calls, sandbox access, legal checkbox), we can target an initial listing submission in 3 weeks and publish in ~6 weeks (cloud vendor dependent).

Next steps I propose:
- You share sandbox creds and an example workload (sample prompts, expected qps)
- We put together SKU mapping + evidence binder and a 45-minute enablement sync
- Confirm who will own the legal/finance intake on the Catalyst side

I'll attach the connector overview now and loop Olga on the technical evidence.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Thanks Megan — quick notes from GTM / co-sell perspective: 

- For co-sell certification the marketplace teams want a short evidence packet + one recorded demo. The recording can be the standard 15–20 minute demo we use for ISV partners.
- Entitlement mapping: recommend mapping Catalyst connector as a separate SKU with an add-on for premium support / priority throughput. This simplifies enablement and attribution.
- Metering: confirm whether Catalyst plans to surface token vs. session usage to customers — helps pick the right metering shim.

Happy to join the enablement call; Rishi, can we lock a 45-minute slot next week?
